newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish car import scheme draws large interest.
newsitem.headline: Turkish car import scheme draws large interest.

text.p: A Turkish government scheme to let Turkish expatriates and resident citizens import cars if they deposit 50,000 German marks in bank accounts has received 21,918 applications so far, Anatolian news agency said on Friday.
It said the deadline for the scheme, which originally included only Turkish expatriates, was December 31, by which date the government expects about 25,000 applications will have been made.

The scheme, in effect since October, allows applicants to bring in one used foreign passanger car of up to five years of age from June 1, 1997 for each 50,000 marks they deposit in the state Ziraat Bank. The deposits will be imposed an annual 10 percent interest.
The scheme was severely criticised by car makers whose sales have dropped by about 25 percent on buyers' expectations of cheaper foreign cars.
